urls.rationale: Chapter 25 (Code of Ethics for Public Officials, Employees, Etc.) is the codified Alabama Ethics Act and contains the lobbyist registration, activity-reporting, and oath sections (§§36-25-1.1, 36-25-22, 36-25-23, 36-25-24).

notes: Single core chapter — Alabama's lobbying-disclosure regime is fully housed within Ch. 25. Chapter 25A (Open Meetings Act) is a related but distinct regime and not part of the lobbying statute body.
